title: Nous Toutes schedules Lille march against gender-based violence

tea.why: Protesters are rallying against gender-based and sexual violence.
tea.want: They demand action against gender-based and sexual violence and visibility for victims.
tea.changed: Nov 27: Organisers agreed on a revised march route with the prefecture after their original path was rejected.

summary: The collective Nous Toutes scheduled a demonstration in Lille on 28 November 2026 to protest gender-based and sexual violence. The group initially submitted a route passing through the Grand Place, but Nord prefecture officials rejected it, citing safety concerns and limited space due to year-end holiday events. Organisers voiced concern that redirecting the march outside the city centre would render victims invisible. Following further discussions, Nous Toutes and the prefecture agreed on an alternative route through central Lille, starting at Rue Nationale and concluding at Place Sébastopol.
response: Prefect of Nord Bertrand Gaume stated that passing thousands of people through the Grand Place was physically impossible due to year-end holiday setups and safety requirements.

updates.text: Nous Toutes agreed on a revised route with local authorities for the 28 November demonstration against gender-based violence in Lille.
